items.summary:
CFO recommendation: retain containment, approve no new spend, monetization forecast, or budget commitment. Amazon evidence covers only 2026-09-21: 6,219 clicks, 28 ordered items, 6 shipped items, and $4.92 commission. The full $4.92 is in an aggregate provider row and cannot be assigned to a site; named site rows show $0 attributed commission. Revenue, contribution margin, ROI, and causal lift are unsupported.

AI usage for 2026-09-01 through 2026-09-30 was $1,002.45979265 across 5,531 calls, including 234 errors and 5 transient errors. This cannot be compared with the one-day revenue window or treated as portfolio margin. Cost-to-learn is not calculable because no per-change AI/infrastructure cost allocation, control or baseline delta, and validated outcome value are available. Minimum measurement: same-period per-change AI and infrastructure cost, treatment/control outcome delta, and attributable revenue or qualified conversion value.

Infrastructure spend, fixed monthly costs, marketing budget, revenue target, and spend limit are blank, so budget exposure and forecast runway are not calculable. Do not convert clicks, orders, shipped items, SEO conversions, or AI output into financial performance. Keep the existing capacity gate and execute only the queued allthingsmasonic.com CTA refinement after the CTO releases one slot; measure registered affiliate clicks and site outcomes without claiming revenue or causal lift.
